title: _spawn_packet accepts any cls string; downstream class-keyed dictionary lookups are unguarded
detail: cls is never checked against SimBalance.CLASS_IDS; an unknown class (harness/test misuse of the documented staging door) hits missing Dictionary keys and errors at admit/drop/deliver.
recommended_fix: Validate at the door: `if not SimBalance.CLASSES.has(cls): return` (or assert) in _spawn_packet before creating the packet.

title: _cmd_set_lanes crashes on type-malformed payloads, violating its documented deterministic no-op contract
detail: apply_command is the public command bus; has() checks existence, not type. A set_lanes with alloc:"x" or cls_lane as non-Dictionary errors on .size()/.has() instead of being a recorded no-op.
recommended_fix: Type-guard before use: `if not (cmd.alloc is Array and cmd.cls_lane is Dictionary): return` after the has() check.

title: Capture harness dereferences nullable bundle_for_pair result and untyped main.get("sim") without guards
detail: bundle_for_pair returns null when no bundle exists and get("sim") returns null-typed Variant; both are dereferenced directly. _run() guards site count and dir errors, these paths don't.
recommended_fix: Null-check after each lookup: `if spine_sim == null or spine_bundle == null: push_error(...); get_tree().quit(1); return` (same for sim/bundle).
